main_text.p: 22:23. Pihel חָנַן Gratiam fecit. Hophal Futur. יְחֻן Gratia fiet, Jef.26.10. Hithpahel הִתְחַנַּן Precari, Deprecari, Supplicem fieri pro gratia consequenda.
חֵין חִין m. חֶנִינָה f. Gratia.
תַּחֲנוּנִים m.p. Preces, Deprecationes: fœmin. תַּחֲנוּנוֹת.
חָנַף Contaminari, Profanari: Contaminare; Profanare: Assentari, Adulari hypocritice. Hiphil הֶחֱנִיף Contaminavit.
חָנֵף m. Profanus, Impurus, Hypocrita: plur. חֲנֵפִים.
חָנַק Strangulavit. Niphal נֶחְנַק Strangulari, Strangulare se.
חֶסֶד m. Benignitas, Beneficentia, Beneficium, Gratia, Misericordia: item, Probrum: plur. חֲסָדִים.
חסד Pihel, Probro afficere. Hithpahel הִתְחַסֵּד Benignum; Beneficum se exhibere.
חָסִיד m. Benignus, Beneficus; Misericors: Sanctus,

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some headword forms are read from a faint, stained scan; the Hebrew entries at the left edge and the lower lines are doubtful and may contain small errors. A dark stain covers the right side of the middle lines. No marginal notes or catchword are visible. The lower-right corner carries a faint digitiser mark, which was omitted.
